registered_before: all four test event financing values and any post-event stock prices are read
study: retrospective development only; Sep18 2026 is chronological holdout but not pristine unseen OOS
cohort: select 60 A-share prefix 600/601/603/605/688/689 from SSE margin detail 2026-05-20, ranked by sha256(code) lexicographically; lock before later events. Do not replace if missing or not executable.

baseline: stock prior 5 session adjusted close return minus CSI300 prior 5 session price index return
stock prior 20 session adjusted close return minus CSI300 prior 20 session price index return
feature_fields.info_time: SSE reports previous day margin details before next open by rule; select T features not earlier than T+1, entry T+2 open conservatively; retrospective initial publication SHA not certified

target: 20 A-share trading sessions T+2 open through T+21 close; use same-vintage forward adjusted OHLC price-only proxy minus CSI300 unadjusted price index same entry and exit; test net separately (not use future sample eligibility)
algorithm: pooled linear OLS on three training events, baseline vs augmented same complete-case training rows; no tuning, standardization or sign flips; test event fixed
metrics: paired 2026-09-18 test MSE (baseline minus augmented), cross-sectional Spearman rank IC for each; same-sample date alone cannot infer robust statistical significance
portfolio: select top 10 predictions among full 60 at-decision feature-observable cohort, do not condition selection on future target available; mainboard min 100 shares, STAR 688/689 min 200 shares under 2026 SSE rule; CNY 100000 cash, 10pct per-name target, min CNY5 commission each way, 10bps slippage each way, sell-side 0.05pct stamp; report original top10 blocked or missing fills with no substitution; price-only adjusted outcome proxy not broker certified
gates: every source query pagination complete for fixed dates and T-5,T-1
at least 40 same complete-case train issuer-event observations and 30 eval issuers; no missing post price rows treated as zero
report both model MSE and sampled test portfolio effects no cherry pick
no trading promotion even if positive; single out-of-time event and old retro source versions cannot constitute independent verified alpha
protected: do not read frozen 122/8, E Fold3/Fold4, 2021/22 holdouts or outcome archives
registration_correction: Before any experiment results were collected, corrected STAR min order 200 shares and top10 membership selection-before-outcome requirement; source official SSE 2026 trading rules article 6.7.
